Three 'everyone' podcast posts (vampires-a-private-equity-cautionary-1bd, toxic-celebrity-culture, hold-my-closer-robitussin) have empty or one-line show notes; counted as full-read with no extractable predictions. Excluded as advocacy rather than forecast: the author's repeated campaign urging the Nobel committee to award Nolan Williams the 2023 Nobel Prize (the-rapid-health-scam-detection-guide footnote; an-inconvenient-truth-about-the-mental footnote). The author's 'Combined Appropriations Act of 2020' refers to the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021. Several posts are satire/fiction (Vampires PE tale, Amazon leak, Theranos) with no sincere forward claims beyond the Theranos item flagged at low specificity.
